description: Change a character's face: eyebrow/eye/mouth patterns, eye and mouth opening, blink, tears, blush, and where the eyes and neck look. Partial and absolute — only the fields you pass are applied, so repeating a call is idempotent. 'eyebrows' and 'eyes' are positions in the character's own pattern list, not asset ids: read 'face.eyebrows_count' / 'face.eyes_count' from studio_list_characters for the valid range, which depends on the character's sex and installed mods. Not undoable from Studio.

eyebrows.description: index into the eyebrow pattern list (0..face.eyebrows_count-1)

eyes.description: index into the eye pattern list (0..face.eyes_count-1)

lip_sync.description: drive the mouth from the character's voice instead of 'mouth_open'

look_eyes.description: eye look-at mode; 4 aims at the character's look-at target instead of the camera

look_neck.description: neck look-at mode — Studio only exposes these four values

expression_categories.description: enable/disable whole expression categories by index, e.g. {"0": false} — the same toggles as Studio's expression panel. Valid indices are the positions of the 'expression' array returned by studio_list_characters.

output.description: the character, same shape as one entry of studio_list_characters — read back 'face' to confirm
